title: Functional anatomy of Pythia-Herwig differences with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.15952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differences between high-energy event generators can arise at several stages of the collision simulation, from the hard scattering through parton showering and hadronization to the final event. These differences are usually summarized using observable distributions or global classifier scores. While these quantify the disagreement, they do not reveal which observable-level structures carry it or whether those structures persist through different stages of event generation. In this work, we formulate this problem as a staged functional analysis of generator-model differences. translated_title: 利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络解析Pythia与Herwig差异的功能解剖
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15952v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：高能事件生成器之间的差异可能出现在碰撞模拟的多个阶段，从硬散射、部分子簇射、强子化到最终事件。这些差异通常通过可观测分布或全局分类器得分来概括。虽然这些方法能量化不一致性，但它们无法揭示哪些可观测层面的结构承载了这些差异，以及这些结构是否在事件生成的不同阶段持续存在。在本工作中，我们将此问题表述为生成器模型差异的分阶段功能分析。通过跟踪相同的硬双喷流事件在Pythia和Herwig中经过仅簇射、强子化和完整生成器三个层次，我们利用分类器导出的对数密度比的加性Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）表示，将学习到的差异分解为显式的一维可观测响应，这些响应可以被隔离、重组和迁移。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的分阶段功能分析方法，将Pythia与Herwig生成器间的差异分解为可解释的一维可观测响应，从而揭示差异在事件生成各阶段的结构与持续性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a staged functional analysis method using Kolmogorov-Arnold networks to decompose Pythia-Herwig generator differences into interpretable one-dimensional observable responses, revealing the structure and persistence of discrepancies across event generation stages.
